rootCause: The liquidity mining project Narwhal’s token experienced two considerable drops within a two day period leading to an overall slippage of approximately 99%. descriptions.text: The liquidity mining project Narwhal’s token experienced two considerable drops within a two day period leading to an overall slippage of approximately 99%. The project’s official X account @Narwhal_fyi, announced that they had experienced an exploit, but did not give any specific details. On-chain links suggest this incident was an exit scam. Approximately $1 million worth of funds were deposited into Tornado Cash with a further $410,000 sitting in two wallets.

In January 2024, Narwhal's NRW token suffered a catastrophic loss of over $1.5 million in two rapid events on BNB Chain. Both incidents were traced to project-controlled wallets and contracts, indicating insider removal of liquidity rather than an external technical exploit. Privileged project-controlled wallets and contracts enabled owner or insider-triggered mass withdrawal and sale of NRW tokens. The withdrawal contract allowed the owner to set a signer for authorization, meaning the exploit could be performed by those with admin privilege or colluding insiders.
